prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is in range, then if object is touchable, grab it, process it, otherwise move. Do it now.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> </Sequence> <Fallback>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />         <Action ID = GrabObject    />         <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />     </Sequence>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />         <Action ID = ApproachObject    />     </Sequence>     <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> </Fallback> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectInRange? THEN
			SELECTOR
				SEQUENCE
						IF IsObjectTouchable? THEN
						DO GrabObject
				ELSE
					DO ProcessObject
				END
				DO MoveToObject
			END
	END
